data.title: Blaze forces families to abandon Turkish tour boat
data.description: ISTANBUL — More than 100 people had to abandon ship after a fire engulfed a children's entertainment tour boat off southwestern Turkey on Thursday, officials said.

data.title: Household power bills to fall from Sept 1
data.description: Household electricity bills have been poised to fall from September after regulators approved a new tariff structure that removes public street-lighting costs from residential bills and caps the rate for the first 200 units of monthly consumption at no more than 3 baht per unit.

data.title: ERC confirms lower power bills from Sep

data.title: 'How many will die?': the mysterious ailment killing Kenyan elephants
data.description: KIMANA (KENYA) - Lying on the ground and kicking up a cloud of dust, an elephant slowly exhausts himself in a futile attempt to stand, the latest potential victim of a still-mysterious ailment in southern Kenya.

data.title: Maghreb sees demographic shift with fertility at historic low
data.description: TUNIS - Economic pressures and changing social norms are driving couples in Tunisia, Morocco, and Algeria to have fewer babies, with a recent study saying Maghreb fertility was at a historic low.

data.title: Policeman caught smoking meth during online training
data.description: PHATTHALUNG: An investigation has been launched after a police officer was allegedly caught using methamphetamine during an online training session attended by hundreds of fellow officers.

data.title: Cobra Gold 2027 ‘to proceed as planned’
data.description: Thailand and the United States will proceed with the Cobra Gold 2027 military exercises according to the original plan, a spokesman for the Ministry of Defence said on Thursday.

data.title: Romania shuts down nuclear plant as Danube drops
data.description: BUCHAREST - Romania halted operations of its only nuclear plant on Thursday, a rare shutdown due to a drought scorching Europe that has caused the Danube river, whose waters cool the plant, to fall to record lows.

data.title: Court acquits actress Pinky in Forex-3D Ponzi case
data.description: The Criminal Court on Thursday acquitted actress Savika “Pinky” Chaiyadej, her mother and her elder brother in the high-profile Forex-3D investment fraud case, while sentencing Forex-3D founder Apiruk Kothi and four other defendants to lengthy prison terms.

data.title: US ambassador denounces ‘thuggish’ Israeli settlers
data.description: QUSRA, Palestinian Territories - Israeli forces on Thursday moved against rogue settlers who have besieged Palestinians amid unusually strong US criticism, even as Israel inaugurated a major settlement elsewhere in the West Bank.

data.title: Israeli envoy seeks closer ties in Surat Thani
data.description: SURAT THANI - Alona Fisher-Kamm, the Israeli ambassador to Thailand, on Thursday reaffirmed cooperation with local authorities on tourism, business and public safety issues involving the southern province’s growing Israeli community.

data.title: IGNIV Circle debuts with an intimate champagne, caviar and cooking experience
data.description: Bangkok, Thailand – August 13, 2026 – IGNIV Bangkok (one MICHELIN Star) introduces IGNIV Circle, a new quarterly masterclass and lunch series with a MICHELIN-starred chef that brings guests closer to the people, philosophy, and techniques behind IGNIV's sharing concept. The inaugural edition, taking place on Sunday, August 23, 2026 , invites guests to an intimate afternoon of Champagne, caviar, and cooking led by IGNIV Bangkok Restaurant Manager & Sommelier Christian Hotz and Joël Ellenberger, Head Chef of the two MICHELIN-starred IGNIV Bad Ragaz in Switzerland, who is currently in residence at IGNIV Bangkok.

data.title: Thailand seizes more assets of Chinese tycoon Chen Zhi
data.description: Thailand is moving to confiscate another 115 million baht in assets linked to the Chinese-Cambodian tycoon Chen Zhi, who is now awaiting trial in China for financial crimes.

data.title: Korean drug and fraud fugitive arrested in Phuket
data.description: PHUKET - A South Korean fugitive accused of drug trafficking and fraud was arrested in this island province on Wednesday, after overstaying his Thai visa for more than eight years.

data.title: Moo Deng gets swallowed whole in snake movie promo
data.description: Moo Deng joins a cast of global household-name animals that have been swallowed whole in promotional posters for the giant snake movie “Beware Boiúna”.

data.title: Raid nets thousands of illegally imported Japanese products
data.description: More than 83,000 items of illegally imported Japanese skincare and household product brands, worth 8.3 million baht, have been seized at a warehouse in Samut Prakan, consumer protection police said on Thursday.

data.title: Taiwan says AI agents used in cyberattacks targeting island
data.description: TAIPEI - Overseas hackers used artificial intelligence agents to help carry out a wave of cyberattacks targeting Taiwanese government agencies in July, the island's digital affairs ministry said Thursday.

data.title: Ageing in place: A home that matches life’s pace
data.description: Ageing and housing are undeniably intertwined. A home can accompany us through every stage of life, from childhood and adulthood to old age, reflecting the concept of ageing in place — growing old in one’s own home or familiar community.

data.title: Gun prize giveaway prompts policy change
data.description: An event in which public officials on Koh Phangan received shotguns as draw prizes will be the last of its kind, a senior Interior Ministry official said on Thursday.

data.description: Long-standing partners to provide stable, long-term ownership andaccelerate the worldwide growth of one of the world’s mostrecognisedKorean-food brands

data.title: Rising Mekong closely watched as rain persists
data.description: Weather forecasters are paying very close attention to the rising water level of the Mekong River, which increases the flood risk in northern provinces nearby.

data.title: Free shuttle brings Bangkok visitors to Ayutthaya cultural showcase
data.description: A new cultural programme by TAT brings Thai craftsmanship, Khon performances and rotating art exhibitions to Ayutthaya’s Koh Kerd, with a free Bangkok shuttle running until December 26.

data.title: ONE Championship: Kiamran Nabati reveals dengue scare before first loss, wants Yod-IQ rematch for title
data.description: Kiamran Nabati wants Yod-IQ Or Pimolsri to dethrone ONE Championship bantamweight Muay Thai king Rambolek – and give him the chance to avenge his first career defeat with the title at stake.

data.title: ONE Championship: Nico Carrillo tells Tom Keogh ‘back of the line’ after title call-out
data.description: Nico Carrillo has dismissed rising Irish prospect Tom Keogh as “another dreamer” and told him to go to the “back of the line” after his ONE Championship title call-out.

data.title: Putin visits Kuril islands claimed by Japan
data.description: MOSCOW - Russian President Vladimir Putin visited the far-eastern Kuril islands for the first time on Thursday, prompting a “strong” protest by Japan which also claims the territory.

data.title: Six injured in knife and shotgun attack at fair
data.description: NAKHON RATCHASIMA - Motorcycle theft suspects attacked people with a shotgun and knife at a fair in Dan Khun Thot district of this northeastern province late Wednesday night. An arrested assailant said his group had been unfairly accused of bike theft.

data.title: Malaysian traveller dies during Bangkok airport transit
data.description: A Malaysian passenger collapsed and later died of a heart attack during a transit at Suvarnabhumi Airport, Bernama reported on Wednesday.

data.title: Hong Kong student arrested over B12.5m scam deceived by same swindlers
data.description: Hong Kong police have arrested a 19-year-old university student accused of swindling more than HK$3 million (12.5 million baht) from a man after apparently being hoodwinked by scammers herself.
